name: Generalized Trilinear Interpolation
definition: A reconstruction method to interpolate AMR data across refinement level boundaries, ensuring C0 continuity and avoiding artifacts/cracks by using virtual unstructured elements to initialize octant vertices.
summary: Generalized Trilinear Interpolation computes field values at arbitrary points in Block-Structured Adaptive Mesh Refinement data by initializing octant vertices with precomputed weights derived from virtual unstructured elements, ensuring continuity across refinement level boundaries.
